messages:
Samir: FYI — seeing a reproducible quality delta after converting Llama4 -> QwenLite int4. Likely token-id remap left a one-off that's shifting rotary phase.

Jordan: How big a delta? repro steps?

Samir: On summarization eval: ROUGE-L -12% relative, ppl +8%. Repro: `convert_model --from llama4 --to qwenlite --quant int4 --token-map token_map.json` then run `eval/summarize/runner.py --model converted`.

Ciara: Can you paste first 10 token ids before/after for a failing sample?

Samir: sure — original ids: `[101, 202, 305, 409, 512, 613, 714, 815, 916, 1007]` -> converted: `[101, 201, 304, 409, 512, 613, 714, 815, 916, 1007]` — notice 202->201 and 305->304 (off by one on subrange)

Jordan: that kind of shift will rotate sin/cos maps out of phase. check kv-cache tokenid offsets too — we saw similar with headwise packing.

Ciara: paste a tiny log from the forward pass where kvcache indexes are used.

Samir: log snippet:
```
Layer 3 head 7: kvcache_index=1245 -> tokenid 304 expected phase idx 152, found 151
rotary_phase_lookup[151] != rotary_phase_lookup[152] -> mismatch
```

Maya: Try running the `token-map-normalize` pass (in tools/convert/). It fixes contiguous ranges where unused ids shifted.

Samir: I ran `token-map-normalize token_map.json out.json --preserve-specials` — mapped ranges collapsed, but then quant packer failed on alignment for GEMMA layout.

Ciara: For GEMMA vs QWEN layouts we need to also normalize headstride/order then reapply `--rotary-offset=auto` during export. There's a `--rotary-offset-fix` flag in `llama2qwen` tool.

Jordan: Benchmark idea: embed-cos-sim check on first 5k tokens post-conversion; require >0.999 for topk.

deploy-bot: conversion-job/842 completed: artifacts at s3://redwood-models/conv/842 (size 1.2GB)

Samir: I'll re-run conversion with `--rotary-offset-fix --preserve-specials` and per-channel quantization turned off (try per-tensor) to isolate quant vs tokenmap.

Maya: Also add a tokenizer mapping unit test: map range remap tests + kvcache index consistency. Can one of you open a tiny PR?

Ciara: I'll open PR with test vectors and a small fuzz runner.

Jordan: If nightly eval still fails, escalate to runtime team — might be subtle kernel ordering flip.

Samir: Plan: run conversions tonight, re-run smoke eval (summarize & chat), post results in this thread. Assign: Samir (conversion), Ciara (tests), Maya (triage owner). Thanks :white_check_mark:

Maya: ack :thumbsup:
